source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed, complete) | Profit Before Tax and EPS added from Williamson Tea Kenya Plc audited results for the year ended 31 March 2025, 31 March 2024 and 31 March 2022, NSE filing library. The 2025 statement prints Revenue 4,108,740, Loss/Profit before taxation (254,991), Tax credit 89,209, Loss/Profit for the year (166,439) and Earnings per share (8.76); the 2024 statement prints the 2024 and 2023 columns; the 2022 statement prints the 2022 and 2021 columns. Profit Before Tax here is the total pre-tax result so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals the Net Profit row on screen: it is the printed continuing-operations figure plus the discontinued-operations loss of 657 in FY2025, 97 in FY2024, 69 in FY2023 and 10,438 in FY2022 in KShs thousands, a line the panel has no row for. Tax is normalised to the printed charge, sign included. | kenyanstocks.com financial statements API, farmed harvest. Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2022 from the source line Income Tax Credit/(Expense); Income Tax FY2023 from the source line Income Tax Credit/(Expense); Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Income Tax Credit/(Expense); Income Tax FY2025 from the source line Income Tax Credit/(Expense).
